gripOrHq.title: Political Coup
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Put [12] from the bank on Political Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Political Coup, if it has any bits.

gripOrHq.title: Corporate Coup
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Put [15] from the bank on Corporate Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Corporate Coup, if it has any bits.

gripOrHq.title: D'Arc Knight
gripOrHq.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.

gripOrHq.title: Chimera
gripOrHq.rulesText: When Runner accesses Chimera, trash a daemon.

discardCards.title: Synchronized Attack on HQ
discardCards.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. For each card stored in HQ, the Corp either pays [2] or discards that card.

ice.title: Haunting Inquisition
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Runner cannot make another run during his or her next six actions.
[Subroutine] End the run.

signal.concretePurposeCode: Reduce the known Corp HQ overflow through one exact current non-agenda hand conversion, then observe and revalidate.
